projects.title: STM32 Polyphonic Sound Synthesizer
projects.summary: Designed and built a standalone synthesizer around the STM32F411. MIDI input triggers up to six simultaneous notes, each with two wavetable oscillators. Audio is generated in real time and sent to a PCM5102 DAC.

diagram.title: System overview
diagram.subtitle: From playing a note to hearing the audio

stages.title: Generate
stages.description: Six voices, two wavetable oscillators each

stages.title: Shape & mix
stages.description: ADSR envelopes, LFO and shared low-pass filter

diagram.note: The STM32F411 handles synthesis and streaming; a 2×16 LCD displays controls via I2C.

details.title: Generating sound efficiently
details.description: Direct digital synthesis uses precomputed waveforms rather than calculating samples from scratch. Each voice has an ADSR envelope with an additional fade-out stage to reduce clicks when a note is retriggered.

details.title: Keeping audio continuous
details.description: While DMA sends one half of the audio buffer to the DAC, the CPU fills the other. This separates audio processing from transmission so multiple notes can play without blocking the output stream.

projects.title: Automated Financial Lead Analysis
projects.summary: Worked on an n8n pipeline that turns a company identifier into a structured business assessment. The system coordinates financial filing retrieval, optional web research and LLM-based scoring.

diagram.title: Analysis pipeline
diagram.subtitle: Four coordinated n8n workflows, from queue to scored results

stages.title: Select
stages.description: Pick pending companies from Google Sheets

stages.title: Collect
stages.description: Request filings and store PDF documents

stages.title: Research
stages.description: Enrich with fleet, ownership and business signals

stages.title: Score
stages.description: Select Master or EV analysis path

stages.title: Deliver
stages.description: Write structured results and recommended actions

details.title: Asynchronous retrieval
details.description: An orchestrator handles queued companies sequentially; document scraping runs as an external job whose status is polled before the generated files are uploaded to Google Drive.

details.title: Evidence-informed scoring
details.description: Optional web research extracts ownership, fleet, hiring and sustainability signals. Separate Master and EV scorecards evaluate business opportunities or electric-vehicle readiness.

details.title: Structured data and reliability
details.description: Schema-constrained LLM outputs map to spreadsheet columns. Retries, polling limits and consistent data contracts are key concerns for the long-running workflows.

projects.note: Internal internship system; this overview excludes client data, private endpoints and credentials.

projects.title: AI-Enhanced Polling Application
projects.summary: A Django polling backend with AI-assisted question generation and chatbot interactions.
projects.description: Django models manage questions, choices and votes. LangGraph coordinates conversational state and external tools, including search, while JSON endpoints connect the backend to the frontend. Langfuse helps inspect agent runs.

projects.title: Alternative Tic-Tac-Toe
projects.summary: A React game with overwritable squares, freezing and move-history navigation.
projects.description: Custom rule validation governs move legality, player turns, frozen cells, overwrite conditions and winner detection. React renders the board from saved state snapshots, allowing navigation through earlier moves.

projects.title: EV Charging Location Discovery
projects.summary: Worked on identifying and assessing candidate charging locations with Overpass API data from OpenStreetMap and routing context from OpenRouteService. The challenge was combining heterogeneous geospatial inputs into comparable site candidates. Internal project.

projects.title: Godot Visual Novel
projects.summary: Developed interactive visual-novel content in Godot and performed web-application testing on a Laravel HR platform.
